title: VISTA: Auditing Semantic Divergence in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating semantic divergence, personality trait attribution, and selective refusal rates across visual queries of different racial and ethnic groups (Asian, Black, Hispanic, Middle Eastern, White) using cross-model semantic clustering.
Measuring entity stance consistency by computing multi-model semantic entropy and divergence on open-ended queries about corporate logos and brand imagery (e.g., McDonald's, Tesla, Amazon).

Assessing cross-model divergence and stance uniformity on synthetic and real images representing ideological concepts (e.g., climate change, feminism, gun control) using bidirectional entailment clustering.
Calculating semantic divergence and suspicion scores for model responses to documentary-style images representing specific political topics (e.g., immigration policy, government surveillance).
